items.excerpt: Raygun, an AI framework from Duke University, converts proteins into standardized mathematical representations learned from millions of natural sequences, letting researchers create shorter, longer and highly modified versions of proteins while preserving their structure and function.

Google Research demonstrated a reinforcement-learning framework in which an autonomous agent learns from quantum error detections to continuously steer thousands of control parameters, letting a quantum computer self-calibrate mid-computation instead of resetting.

University of Maryland researchers built a standardized solid-state battery database of 245 records and 167 structured variables to enable consistent reporting and power AI-driven solid-state battery design and optimization.

IMDEA Materials Institute researchers developed an AI-powered ultrasound method that reconstructs a complete, accurate image from a single fixed sensor capturing one signal at a single instant, eliminating the need for complex multisensor arrays.
